title: Update policy for higher field failure cost
body:
Field failure cost changed from $1850 to $2400; other memo parameters are unchanged.

This lowers the threshold from 0.027 to 0.008 and widens the abstain band to 0.007–0.186, increasing abstention share. Full curves are attached by the tool for review.

## Parameter changes
- `field_failure_cost_usd`: 1850.0 -> 2400.0
